title: On relation of the genus one Moore-Seiberg identity to the Baxter Q-operator in the hyperbolic Ruijsenaars model
summary: In this paper we show how the Baxter Q-operator and the product formula for eigenfunctions of two-particle hyperbolic Ruijsenaars system can be derived from the genus one Moore-Seiberg duality identity in two-dimensional Liouville conformal field theory. We expect that this relation would reveal genuine role of the Moore-Seiberg identity in integrable systems.
